title: Alien with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#4be08a'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='14' ry='15' fill='#a6f7c6'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#2fd576'/>
  <!-- head shading top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='26' ry='14' fill='#7ff0a8'/>
  <!-- antenna stems -->
  <line x1='36' y1='14' x2='31' y2='4' stroke='#2fd576' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='14' x2='69' y2='4' stroke='#2fd576' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna balls -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='5' r='5' fill='#ff9be0'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='5' r='5' fill='#ff9be0'/>
  <!-- eye whites -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='36' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='36' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- irises -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='37' r='7' fill='#3a2bd6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='37' r='7' fill='#3a2bd6'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='37' r='3.4' fill='#100a40'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='37' r='3.4' fill='#100a40'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='33' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#8ff3ff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#8ff3ff'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tiny star glints -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='28' r='2' fill='#ffe66b'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='46' r='2' fill='#ffe66b'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 50 Q50 57 58 50' stroke='#1a8f4c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <line x1='27' y1='66' x2='16' y2='76' stroke='#2fd576' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='73' y1='66' x2='84' y2='76' stroke='#2fd576' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff9be0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ff9be0'/>
</svg>
